card-description: Uploads nobody uses, removed from storage. Preview what a run would delete, then run it.
clips-description: Recordings that no profile names any more and that are over a week old.
confirm-body-clips: Looks at up to {{limit}} pronunciation clips and deletes those no profile uses that are over a week old. This cannot be undone. Preview first to see which.
confirm-body-media: Deletes up to {{limit}} stored uploads nobody uses, oldest first, with their smaller sizes. This cannot be undone. Preview first to see which.
flag-off: The scheduled sweeps are off. Nothing runs at night.
line-capped: The limit for one run was reached; the rest waits for the next run.
line-clips: {{listed}} clips looked at, {{referenced}} in use, {{fresh}} kept for being under a week old or having no time
line-done: {{deleted}} deleted, {{failed}} failed (they stay and are tried again)
line-rows: {{scanned}} rows looked at, {{kept}} kept because something still uses them
line-rules: {{pending}} never attached, {{soft}} from deleted posts past the recycle bin, {{hard}} from posts that are gone
load-error: The sweep state could not be loaded.
media-description: Uploads never attached to a post after a day, and the pictures of posts deleted past their recycle-bin window. A picture a scheduled post, a flashcard or a build page still uses is kept.
page-description: Stored uploads nobody uses, removed on a schedule. Preview what a run would delete before it runs.
preview-error: The preview could not be made.
runs-description: Runs started from this page. The scheduled runs are in the jobs log, as counts only.
runs-empty-description: A run started here is listed once it is done.
schedule-description: The uploads sweep runs nightly and the clip sweep weekly, once the media-sweep flag is on.
